messages:
maya: heads up y'all — i'm at the DTLA office today. who wants to join a quick lunch run? tacos truck outside or try the new micro-cafe on 5th? :taco: :coffee:
oscar: tacos truck every time for me. their al pastor is fire.
priya: the micro-cafe (Bloom & Grind) has decent salads and decent wifi if anyone wants to eat upstairs.
jon: also heard there's a ramen pop-up in the alley today around 12:40. three-way dilemma.
maya: options: 1) Tacos truck (fast, messy) 2) Bloom & Grind (sit, nicer) 3) Ramen pop-up (longer line). Vote with emoji pls.
oscar: :taco: +1
priya: :coffee: +1 (leaning cafe)
jon: :ramen: +1 but i might be late if there's a line
maya: quick logistics — i have 40 minutes before my 1pm call. if we pick ramen we should split into two groups.
oscar: i'm faster solo, can grab tacos for the team if you want a pickup.
priya: can you grab one vegan taco for me? (no onions)
oscar: noted. vegan + no onion.
jon: i'll try to scope the ramen line at 12:30 and report back.
foodbot: Ramen pop-up ETA: 10-20min queue based on live check. Bloom & Grind wait: 0 min for seating at 12:25. Tacos truck line: ~5min.
maya: oof ramen looks long. i'm team tacos or cafe today. need something quick.
priya: tacos sound good — but maybe grab tables at Bloom & Grind for those who want to sit. we'll split.
oscar: i'll do taco run for the grabbers. who's in for taco order? list below.
maya: me: al pastor + extra lime.
priya: vegan taco, no onions, add avocado if possible.
jon: carnitas, mild salsa.
oscar: ordering: 2 al pastor, 1 vegan (no onion), 1 carnitas. any sides? chips + salsa?
maya: yes chips please if it's not too heavy.
priya: chips ok. i'm allergic to shellfish fyi.
jon: none for me.
oscar: got it. i'll leave napkins and utensils in the lobby. ETA 12:38.
maya: thanks oscar! meeting folks at lobby 12:34 and we'll head out.
jon: if ramen line clears i might run back for seconds and bring to table.
priya: love this hybrid plan :raised_hands:
foodbot: Reminder: Maya has 13:00 meeting (30min). Recommended return by 12:50.
oscar: delivering now. will ping when back in lobby.
maya: appreciate it — see you in 10 :taco: :sparkles:
